ssl.note: Railway's postgres-ssl image terminates TLS itself and issues its own certificate; SSL_CERT_DAYS is one of the variables it publishes. The provisioning job additionally asserts the session is encrypted rather than trusting the image.

tcpProxy.purpose: External reachability for a future Microsoft Fabric connection. Not used by the website, which has no database connection at all.

databaseSetup.name: arpi-database-setup
databaseSetup.note: Runs the repository's ordered SQL sequence, creates the login roles, loads the deterministic development profile and verifies the result, then exits. It is not a backend API: it serves no traffic, has no public domain, no health check, and a NEVER restart policy so a completed run is not restarted into a loop.

serviceDependencies.reason: The provisioning job reads the database over the project's private network using reference variables. Nothing is copied.

deliberatelyAbsent.backendWebService: The ARPI architecture has no general-purpose backend. The website is fourteen statically prerendered routes with no runtime data source, so a backend would be a service with nothing to serve.
deliberatelyAbsent.websiteDatabaseAccess: The website holds no database credential, opens no connection, and is not granted a reference to one. Verified by scripts/railway/verify_railway_configuration.ts.
deliberatelyAbsent.productionEnvironment: No production deployment has been approved. The bootstrap tool refuses to create or modify a production environment.
deliberatelyAbsent.prEnvironments: Evaluated and deliberately not enabled; see deployment/railway/README.md section 9.
